mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.kb_id AS "kbId", d.title, d.status, d.data_label AS "dataLabel", d.error_message AS "errorMessage", d.parse_status AS "parseStatus", d.active_version AS "activeVersion", b.workspace_id AS "workspaceId", COALESCE(d.update_at, d.create_at) AS "occurredAt" FROM kb_document d LEFT JOIN kb_base b ON b.id = d.kb_id WHERE d.deleted = FALSE AND COALESCE(d.update_at, d.create_at) >= #{from} AND COALESCE(d.update_at, d.create_at) <= #{to} ORDER BY COALESCE(d.update_at, d.create_at), d.id
